title: WMAdapter: Adding WaterMark Control to Latent Diffusion Models

source_version.publication: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR volume 267 (2025)
source_version.version_basis: official publisher linked PDF acquired on retrieval date, frozen by SHA-256

inspection_outcome: Two bounded unresolved calibration/evaluation findings; scoped positive method checks
summary: No demonstrated Major. The binomial tail is valid under stated stronger joint assumptions or independent uniform random keys; fixed-key empirical calibration remains unknown. Relative PSNR drops with unequal initial quality do not determine intrinsic removal cost. Core architecture and displayed ablations are coherent.

problems.title: Fixed-key detection calibration is unverified
assumptions: Fixed-key deployment differs from averaging over independently sampled uniform keys
problems.check: Exact rational binomial sums; correlated-null diagnostic; independent uniform-key conditioning proof
problems.result: M>=41 has probability3.1202042194422575e-7 under binomial null; marginal fairness alone is insufficient, but random-key average calibration can be exact
problems.counterevidence: Uniform independent target key yields binomial matches for any decoder output; nominal conservative level is valid; no observed decoder failure
problems.impact: Cannot identify claimed fixed-key operating level without null/calibration records; bit accuracy and closed-set tracing are not refuted

correction.statement: Supply actual cutoff, key sampling/conditioning and fixed-key null calibration or narrow the level claim
correction.limits: No implementation or null scores available

focused_acceptance.assumptions_and_decisive_evidence: The source moves from fair marginal decoded bits to Binomial(48,1/2). A fixed key or its complement, each with probability 1/2, has fair bit marginals but tail probability 1/2. The nominal threshold calculation P(M>=41)=87825941/2^48 is about 3.120204e-7 and is consistent with a 1e-6 nominal bound.
focused_acceptance.counterevidence_and_limits: An independently uniform random target key yields an exact key-averaged binomial match count for any decoder output. This essential counterevidence is retained; the counterexample does not prove actual fixed-key miscalibration.
focused_acceptance.core_dependency_and_severity: Needs Evidence is retained for empirical fixed-key calibration rather than a demonstrated system failure.
focused_acceptance.correction_scope: Clarify the null/key sampling protocol and provide fixed-key calibration evidence; no replacement FPR is asserted for the real detector.

problems.title: Regeneration robustness comparison does not isolate initial quality
problems.outcome: Unresolved absolute attack cost and operating comparison
problems.claim: 4–6dB PSNR drop versus2dB establishes better regeneration robustness
problems.location: Section4.3 pp6–7; Fig5 p8; Table2 p7
assumptions: PSNR references and peak need to match
Illustrative MSE arithmetic does not reconstruct actual attack samples
problems.check: Parent inspected actual plot and computed relation between starting MSE and PSNR drop
problems.result: A larger dB drop can have smaller absolute MSE increment; original-relative PSNR does not identify attack perturbation because of cross terms
problems.counterevidence: Relative drop observation may be correct; absolute curves and higher starting quality remain useful tradeoff evidence; white-box and other weaknesses explicitly disclosed
problems.impact: Cannot infer intrinsic resistance or corrected ranking from available relative-drop argument

correction.statement: Provide image triples, references, attack budgets, bit-count distributions and calibrated detection success

focused_acceptance.source_location: Section4.3 pp6–7; Fig5 p8; Table2 p7
focused_acceptance.assumptions_and_decisive_evidence: The source compares roughly 4-6 dB versus 2 dB regeneration drops from unequal starting PSNRs (34.8 versus 29.7). The checked conversion to MSE shows that a larger dB drop need not imply a larger absolute MSE increment.
focused_acceptance.counterevidence_and_limits: Clean-reference MSE change also contains a cross term and is not the squared attack perturbation norm. The actual image triples, attack budgets, and full metric bindings are unavailable.
focused_acceptance.core_dependency_and_severity: Needs Evidence is retained for the robustness attribution. No actual ranking reversal or attack failure is demonstrated by the arithmetic diagnostic.
focused_acceptance.correction_scope: The report correctly requests comparable references/budgets and original triples rather than inventing a corrected robustness ranking.
